Serana: You know, there’s something poetic about a guard changing his armor at one in the morning. It’s like watching a butterfly molt, if butterflies were made of steel and regret. Varnius Junius: Aye, I’ve seen stranger things in Dragon Bridge after a few tankards of mead. But this city never sleeps, does it? Too many secrets rattling around in these stone walls. Daegon: Secrets? More like the Jarl’s court has more skeletons than the Hall of the Dead. I’d bet my rat Korpse could sniff out five conspiracies before dawn. Lydia: Dibella’s tits, can we talk about something that doesn’t involve dead things or politics? I came here to enjoy the night air, not listen to vampire jokes and elf cynicism. Serana: Oh, sweet Lydia, the night air is just the breath of the dead. You’d get used to it after a few centuries. But if you want a fresh topic, how about that guard over there who keeps unequipping his shield like he’s trying to decide if he’s a warrior or a dancer?
Serana: Well, someone’s feeling nocturnal. Did a draugr steal your sweetroll, or are you just practicing your aim at ghosts? Daegon: If you’re trying to hit that guard, you’re about ten feet off.

(*You are observing the following:* The scene depicts a dimly lit, rustic entryway nestled under a heavy timber overhang. Thick, dark wooden beams support a ceiling made of lighter planks, casting deep shadows across the space. A single lantern, encased in dark metal with glowing panes, hangs from one of the beams, providing a warm, localized light source. Below the overhang, a set of large, arched double doors made of dark, weathered wood is set into a rugged stone wall. The stone masonry is uneven and textured, with patches of green vines and foliage creeping down from the eaves and clinging to the sides of the doorway. To the right, a thick, textured pillar or tree trunk forms part of the structure. The ground is composed of uneven stone slabs, leading out toward a patch of dark, pebbly earth in the foreground. The overall atmosphere is quiet, ancient, and somewhat mysterious.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Octieve San, Noster Eagle-Eye, Jaree-Ra, Solitude Guard, Solitude Guard)
